title: Haye Mera Pyasa
body:
haye mera pyasa bhai
<<DIVIDER>>
kaisi qayamat asr ko aayi
ho gayi tan se sar ki judaai
zainab ro ro dewe duhaai
haye mera pyasa bhai...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon may dooba chand sa mukda
halq se tune teer nikala
nanhi lehad bhi khud hi banayi
haye mera pyasa bhai...
<<DIVIDER>>
sabr ki taaqat sab ko dikhadi
ya ali kehkar khaynch li barchi
mayyat e akbar tune uthayi
haye mera pyasa bhai...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis may bandha tha raat may kangna
us may pada hai phanda rasan ka
kubra dekhe apni kalaayi
haye mera pyasa bhai...
<<DIVIDER>>
apna chehra khoon may bhar kar
aaya jo duldul qaime ke dar par
daudti dar pa sakina aayi
haye mera pyasa bhai...
<<DIVIDER>>
asr ke baad aaye hai sataane
reham nahi khaaya aada ne
qaime loote aag lagayi
haye mera pyasa bhai...
<<DIVIDER>>
laakhon ka lashkar tera budhapa
hamle se tere larzan hai kufa
kisne dekhi aisi ladaayi
haye mera pyasa bhai...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti thi mahir zainab e muztar
laasha e sheh se ruqsat hokar
jee bhar kar mai rone na paayi
haye mera pyasa bhai...
author: Mahir Lakhnavi
